_comment: Configuration for /finn-ideate, which is NOT a Finn-loop stage. The loop is spec -> build -> review, each with a human gate on either side; ideation has no such contract and produces raw input for triage. Run it on demand when the agent-ready queue has run dry. It reads guardrails from .claude/finn-loop.json when that file exists, because a guardrail describes this repository rather than the loop - an idea that breaks one can never be built.
brief: Market and competitor moves, the Nigerian/West-African ITSM, compliance, and talent landscape, pricing signals, and tooling trends.
